Hi Elena — brief update and remedy plan.

Thanks for the logs; we've completed our internal verification. Summary and remediation: 

- Eligibility: Confirmed. PulseAI is on Redwood Dedicated under DEAL-74839 and the observed downtime windows (28m + 12m = 40 minutes total) meet the SLA remediation trigger for the billing period of July.

- Calculation method (summary): Per the SLA (section 4.2) remedy = prorated monthly invoice * (downtime minutes / total minutes in month). Using your July usage and the Dedicated monthly commitment from our billing system, Rishi prepared the preliminary calculation below: 
  - Monthly committed invoice (net after discounts): $72,500.00
  - July total minutes: 44640 (31 days * 24 * 60)
  - Downtime minutes: 40
  - Remedy (pro rata): $72,500 * (40 / 44640) = $65.05 (rounded)

- Issuance: We will apply a one-time invoice credit of $65.05 to PulseAI's August invoice. If you prefer instead to receive a separate credit note, we can do that; please confirm.

- Evidence & audit: Attached is the calculation workbook (redwood_remedy-calculation-20260729.xlsx) with logs references and links to the runtime traces we used. We retain the right to adjust final numbers pending any additional telemetry, but the number above is our current final proposal.

Action items: 
- Elena: confirm you want the credit applied to August invoice (default) or a standalone credit note.
- Rishi/Finance: please prepare the credit and update DEAL-74839 in HubSpot once final.

Apologies again for the disruption — we know even small windows matter. We'll share the postmortem summary and mitigation items by early next week.

Best regards,
